_about: Cases for the blocker answer, asserted from BOTH apps/api/tests/test_assistant_query.py (server composer) and apps/web/src/__tests__/blocker-answer-parity.test.ts (the chip composer). `expected` is the chip text; the server answer is `expected` + ' ' + its Open Validator sentence.
Regenerate by changing the SERVER composer first and re-deriving; never hand-edit one side.

cases.name: a fresh record: three bare blocker keys and a root-level finding
cases.expected: 3 fields still need you before export: Reduced Spectrum, QC Status, Required For Evidence Record. The deterministic schema check separately reports 1 record-level validation issue: 'descriptors' is a required property.

cases.name: run-tagged questions name their run, once per run
cases.expected: 4 fields still need you before export: Reduced Spectrum (on run Run A), QC Status (on run Run A), Reduced Spectrum (on run Run B), …and 1 more. No blocking validation issues are listed in the current validation response.

cases.name: an unlabelled run and a run whose label is unsafe
cases.expected: 2 fields still need you before export: Reduced Spectrum (on an unlabelled run), QC Status (on a run whose label is withheld). No blocking validation issues are listed in the current validation response.

cases.name: duplicate findings collapse; one locator with two messages stays two issues
cases.expected: 2 validation issues may be blocking export: assets — 'a' is a required property; assets — 'b' is a required property.

cases.name: an unsafe message and a verdict-language message are withheld alone
cases.expected: 1 field still needs you before export: QC Status. The deterministic schema check separately reports 2 validation issues: assets — (message withheld); sample → id — (message withheld).

cases.name: a message over 160 characters is bounded
cases.expected: 1 validation issue may be blocking export: system → technique — 'zzz' is not one of ['t0', 't1', 't2', 't3', 't4', 't5', 't6', 't7', 't8', 't9', 't10', 't11', 't12', 't13', 't14', 't15', 't16', 't17', 't18', 't19', 't20', '….

cases.name: record-level findings only are named by their messages
cases.expected: 2 record-level validation issues may be blocking export: 'sample' is a required property; 'assets' is a required property.

cases.name: more than three issues are capped and counted
cases.expected: 5 validation issues may be blocking export: assets → 0 — m0 is wrong; assets → 1 — m1 is wrong; assets → 2 — m2 is wrong; …and 2 more.

cases.name: open questions with a clean schema check
cases.expected: 1 field still needs you before export: QC Status. No blocking validation issues are listed in the current validation response.

cases.name: open questions alongside a validation crash
cases.expected: 1 field still needs you before export: QC Status. The deterministic schema check could not be completed for this record, so no blocking locations can be listed.

cases.name: a real locator is shown verbatim
cases.expected: 1 field still needs you before export: ssrl-archive://BL15-2/2099_run_000/raw/scan_0044.dat. No blocking validation issues are listed in the current validation response.
